metadata.article_title: Payment of crossed cheque out of due course.

article.title: Payment of crossed cheque out of due course.
article.content: Any banker paying a cheque crossed generally otherwise than to a banker, or a cheque crossed specially otherwise than to the banker to whom the same is crossed, or his agent for collection, being a banker, shall be liable to the true owner of the cheque for any loss he may sustain owing to the cheque having been so paid.

Section 129 · Chapter XIV · page 26 of the Act
